## How you checked it

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` passes
- [ ] Claims added or edited: `python scripts/kb_gate.py` exits 0 with all snapshots present
- [ ] Claims added or edited: read against the source by someone or something that did not write them. Who or what: <!-- e.g. a second person, or a model session that saw only the claim, quote and page -->
- [ ] A guide or `SKILL.md` changed: calibration run before and after ([evals/README.md](../evals/README.md)); results:
- [ ] Output shape of a script changed: `docs/reference.md` updated, `schema_version` raised if an old consumer would break
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry

Leave unchecked what does not apply.
